issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS CI: 14 hosted XCTests beyond bob-cli-f3 fail on 2884ea2 (clip preview, command accept submit, real keep-moving pull-in order)
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). Master macOS CI run 41435470545 on 2884ea2 ("fix(build): restore the BobMacCapture build and test type-check") is the first master run in a while whose Build step passes. Hosted XCTests therefore ran again, and the Test step fails 21 tests. Seven are already tracked by bob-cli-f3 (line-case undo, three `+` separator toggle tests, two task-type hosted tests, task-type retype). This task covers the other 14, which no bead tracks:

- 11 × `BobMacCaptureTests.CaptureClipPreviewHostedTests` (activation refresh/polling, clipboard counter re-preview, polling teardown/retention, `%c` draft reads the clipboard, counted clip history, focus loss/hide invalidation, ≤1 Hz polling, polling stop on hide/focus loss/draft removal). Most are `XCTAssertTrue failed` or `Condition not met before timeout` at CaptureClipPreviewHostedTests.swift:27-360. Suite origin: a8e2ab6 (read clips in live preview).
- `CapturePanelModelTests.testCommandAcceptInsertsAndSubmits` (line 1570-1572) and `testBlockIDLinkCommandAcceptSubmits` (1872-1874): the insert happens but submission never fires, so the draft stays `^sase:deep-fix` / `@file:ready` instead of `""`.
- `CapturePullInChoiceModelTests.testRealKeepMovingFixtureOpensChoiceAndSubmitsItsOpaqueKey` (lines 79-80): offer order `[^p, ^b, ^a]` vs expected, and the submitted key is `^p` vs `^a`. Suite origin: 90bd9ba (bob-cli-fb.5, block presentation and pull-in choices).

Not caused by bob-cli-fn: all 13 `CaptureListPanelTests` from bob-cli-fn.4 (0f2f46f) pass in the same run. fn.4 changed only project-task block-ID accepts (`blockIDSplice`) and the list-header newline, not active-task command accept, clip preview, or pull-in choice. Build was red on master from roughly bob-cli-fb.5 until 2884ea2, so these hosted tests have not executed on master for many commits. Bisect across that window instead of assuming one culprit.

Evidence: `gh run view 41435470545 -R bobs-org/bob-mac-capture --log-failed`.

Done when a master push (or a `Scripts/macos-ci-check` precommit snapshot) runs these 14 tests green with no assertion weakened. Fix the product when the test reflects the intended contract; update the test only when a later accepted contract deliberately changed the behavior, and cite that change.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Observed on one run only (41435470545), but every failure reports a specific wrong value, not a crash or infrastructure error: drafts left unsubmitted, the offer order p,b,a, and clip-preview assertion mismatches. These hosted tests had not executed on master for many commits because Build was red. Rerun once to confirm before fixing.
